args: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"; if [ -x "$SCRIPT_DIR/plugins/commonwealth-mcp/run-server.sh" ]; then exec "$SCRIPT_DIR/plugins/commonwealth-mcp/run-server.sh" "$@"; elif [ -x "$SCRIPT_DIR/run-server.sh" ]; then exec "$SCRIPT_DIR/run-server.sh" "$@"; elif [ -x "$PWD/.venv/bin/commonwealth" ]; then exec "$PWD/.venv/bin/commonwealth" "$@"; elif command -v commonwealth >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec commonwealth "$@"; elif command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run commonwealth "$@"; else exec python3 -m commonwealth.cli "$@"; fi
